startingPoint.role: documentary STOP commit, accepted as correct and kept as historical evidence

authorizedProductiveScope: CharstringEncoder.move(double,double): emit a Type 1 moveto when the displacement is zero

type1Conformance.source: Adobe Type 1 Font Format, version 1.1 (third printing, February 1993), section 6.4 Charstring Command List
type1Conformance.hsbw: p. 50: sets the current point to (sbx, 0) but does not place it in the character path; rmoveto for the first point
type1Conformance.closepath: p. 51: does not reposition the current point; a subsequent rmoveto is relative to the point before closepath
type1Conformance.hmoveto: p. 52: equivalent to dx 0 rmoveto; 0 hmoveto is a valid zero-displacement moveto
type1Conformance.correction: move(): LAST_POINT case writes 0 hmoveto instead of nothing; BOTH, HORIZONTAL and VERTICAL cases and all other commands unchanged
